en.auth.signup.title: Enter your email to continue
en.auth.signup.subtitle: We'll send a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
en.auth.email.label: Email
en.auth.email.help: We only use this to send your sign-in code.
en.auth.otp.title: Check your inbox
en.auth.otp.tip.title: Tip
en.auth.otp.tip.body: If you don't see it, check spam or Junk.
en.auth.social.title: One tap to start
en.auth.social.subtitle: Use your Google or Apple account. We don't ask for a password.
en.lockout.title: Locked for a few minutes
en.lockout.body: Too many failed sign-in attempts. For your safety we've paused this account.
en.blocked.title: Not yet available here
en.blocked.body: Balsm isn't offered in your country yet. We're working on it.
en.blocked.help: Need help with an existing account? Visit our support page from any country.
en.disclosure.title: How Balsm works
en.disclosure.h.phi: Your health profile stays on this phone
en.disclosure.p.phi: Allergies, medications, conditions, contacts — all stored on your device. We never see them. If you lose your phone, your health profile is gone with it (unless you sign in on a new device using your email/Google/Apple — then we restore from your encrypted backup).
en.disclosure.p.cloud: Only your account info: email, name, country, language, and date of birth (encrypted on our server, so even our staff can't read it without an audited reason).
en.disclosure.h.emergency: If you share an emergency QR
en.disclosure.p.emergency: The QR carries a copy of your card encrypted with a key only the QR holds. Anyone scanning it sees your card. You can revoke it any time.
en.disclosure.p.delete: Settings → Delete account → 7 days to change your mind → everything gone. No "hidden retention", no marketing list.
en.disclosure.consent: By tapping Accept you confirm you've read this.

en.delete.title: Delete account
en.delete.h: Before you go — here's exactly what happens
en.delete.deleted.1: All cloud-side records: email, country, language, encrypted DOB, sessions, audit log
en.delete.deleted.2: Any active emergency QR — revoked immediately
en.delete.retained.1: An anonymous deletion log (no name, no email) — required by regulators
en.delete.grace.title: 7 days to change your mind
en.delete.grace.body: Sign back in within 7 days to cancel deletion.
en.delete.confirm.title: Confirm deletion
en.delete.confirm.body: For your safety, sign in again and type DELETE below.
en.delete.confirm.help: Case-sensitive. We're being careful on purpose.
en.delete.public.title: Delete your Balsm account
en.delete.public.body: No app required. Sign in below to start deletion.
en.delete.public.foot: After sign-in we'll show exactly what's deleted, retained, and wiped — same as the in-app flow.

en.sessions.everywhere: Sign out everywhere except this device

en.language.body: Pick how Balsm talks to you. Switching language updates the whole app instantly.
en.language.numerals: Numbers can use Western (0-9) or Arabic-Indic (٠-٩). Pick in profile → display.
en.404.title: We lost this page
en.404.body: It may have moved, or never existed. Let's get you home.

ar-EG.blocked.title: لسه مش متاح هنا

ar-EG.blocked.help: محتاجة مساعدة في حساب موجود؟ ادخلي على صفحة الدعم من أي بلد.
ar-EG.disclosure.title: بلسم بيشتغل إزاي
ar-EG.disclosure.p.phi: الحساسية، الأدوية، الحالات المزمنة، أرقام الطوارئ — كلها على جهازك. مش بنشوفها. لو ضاع تليفونك، الملف ضاع معاه (إلا لما تسجّلي دخول على جهاز جديد بإيميلك/جوجل/آبل، وقتها بنرجّعهالك من نسخة احتياطية مشفرة).
ar-EG.disclosure.p.cloud: بس بيانات حسابك: الإيميل، الاسم، البلد، اللغة، وتاريخ الميلاد (مشفّر عندنا، حتى موظفونا مش هيقدروا يقرأوه إلا بسبب موثّق).
ar-EG.disclosure.p.emergency: الـ QR بياخد نسخة من بطاقتك مشفّرة بمفتاح موجود جوّاه. أي حد يمسحه، يشوف البطاقة. تقدري تلغيه في أي وقت.
ar-EG.disclosure.p.delete: الإعدادات ← مسح الحساب ← ٧ أيام تغيّري رأيك ← كل حاجة بتتمسح. مفيش احتفاظ مخفي ولا قوائم تسويق.

ar-EG.delete.h: قبل ما تمشي — ده اللي هيحصل بالظبط
ar-EG.delete.deleted.1: كل سجلاتك على السحابة: الإيميل، البلد، اللغة، تاريخ الميلاد المشفّر، الجلسات، سجل التدقيق

auth-country.title: Country picker
auth-country.layout: List with sticky search + flag chips
auth-country.rtl: List mirrors; flag stays LTR; phone code mono LTR
rules: Blocked countries shown disabled, not hidden

auth-email.title: Email signup
auth-email.layout: Single email field + social-or divider + pinned CTA
auth-email.a11y: Email keyboard type; autocomplete='email'; floating label
auth-email.rtl: Email field forced LTR; label + helper RTL
rules: No password — OTP only per spec

auth-otp.title: OTP verification
auth-otp.layout: 6 OTP boxes + countdown + resend ghost + help banner
auth-otp.a11y: One-time-code keyboard on iOS; per-cell aria-label; aria-live for expiry
auth-otp.rtl: OTP cells LTR (digits enter L→R); text + label RTL

auth-social.title: Social sign-in
auth-social.a11y: Native widgets retain a11y; clear focus order
auth-social.rtl: Apple/Google lockups stay LTR; rest RTL
rules: Google + Apple only — no Phone OTP

auth-lockout.title: Lockout
auth-lockout.layout: Central card with countdown + support escape
auth-lockout.a11y: aria-live polite, announce minute changes not seconds
auth-lockout.rtl: Countdown LTR mono; surrounding text RTL

auth-blocked.title: Geofence blocked
auth-blocked.layout: Warning icon + cause + alternative + notify CTA

disclosure.title: Consolidated disclosure
disclosure.layout: Authority chip + 4 sections + privacy/terms links + pinned accept
disclosure.a11y: Long-form scrollable; CTA unlocks on scroll-to-bottom
disclosure.rtl: Headings + body RTL; supervisory chip flexes

home.title: Home (filled)
home.layout: Greeting + accent card + today summary + suggested list + bottom nav
home.a11y: Greeting includes user's name; nudges have aria-describedby
home.rtl: Bottom nav order mirrors (Q1 — recommend rightmost = Home)
rules: Always show 'Today at a glance' once meds added

account-handle.title: Handle claim
account-handle.layout: Field + suggestions chip-row + global-account banner + pinned CTA
account-handle.a11y: Live validation announced on blur; conflict state clear
account-handle.rtl: Handle field forced LTR (latin-only); label + suggestions RTL
rules: Conflict → red border + tip on resolution

profile-editor.title: Health profile editor
profile-editor.layout: Privacy marker + 4 section cards (blood, allergies, conditions, contacts)
profile-editor.a11y: Privacy marker announces 'on-device only'; severity announced
profile-editor.rtl: Phone numbers mono LTR; names mixed-direction
rules: Add modal opens as bottom sheet
Save persists locally, no cloud sync

emergency-card.title: Emergency card
emergency-card.layout: Card with cross icon + identity + clinical rows + share CTA
emergency-card.a11y: Card content read in priority order: blood, allergies, conditions
emergency-card.rtl: Identity RTL; phone mono LTR; clinical labels RTL
rules: Blood type emphasized via color + size
Share CTA opens TTL picker, not immediate

emergency-qr.title: QR display
emergency-qr.layout: QR canvas + countdown + TTL picker + regen/revoke pair
emergency-qr.a11y: Long-press QR for accessibility read; countdown announced
rules: QR module color: pure ink-900 black (Q3 recommendation)
Brand mark center, white halo for contrast

emergency-public.title: Public emergency resolve (Web)
emergency-public.layout: Web header + emergency banner + identity card + call CTA + privacy footer
emergency-public.rtl: Labels in patient's preferred_language; phone mono LTR
rules: Decrypt happens client-side via URL fragment key
Page renders without JS where possible (SSR fallback)
Locale toggle independent of patient locale

meds-list.title: Medication list
meds-list.layout: List + on-track chips + controlled badge + FAB
meds-list.a11y: Each med announces name + schedule + status
meds-list.rtl: List mirrors; FAB on trailing edge in RTL
rules: FAB always reachable above bottom nav

meds-add.title: Add medication
meds-add.layout: Name + dose pair + shape chips + day grid + times list + pinned save
meds-add.a11y: Day grid uses pressed state aria-pressed
meds-add.rtl: Day grid stays L→R (Sat→Fri) per Hijri-week shape regardless of dir

meds-today.title: Today
meds-today.layout: Tz banner + upcoming list + earlier list
meds-today.rtl: Times mono LTR; med rows mirror
rules: Append-only: 'Taken' creates dose event, never edits

deletion-preconfirm.title: Delete (pre-confirm)
deletion-preconfirm.layout: 3 categorized cards (deleted/wiped/retained) + grace banner + pair CTA
deletion-preconfirm.a11y: Destructive CTA spatially separated; cause+consequence announced
deletion-preconfirm.rtl: Lists mirror; CTA row mirrors (cancel leading)
rules: Color-code: danger-bg for deleted, neutral for wiped, info for retained
Two equal-weight buttons OK here since cancel is non-destructive default

deletion-confirm.title: Delete (final confirm)
deletion-confirm.layout: Read-only email + OTP + typed-confirm + danger CTA
rules: Triple gate: re-auth + OTP + typed confirm
DELETE must be exact case-sensitive match

deletion-public.title: Public delete (Web)
deletion-public.layout: Web header + title + 3-channel re-auth + foot promise
deletion-public.a11y: Same as in-app; no app chrome

sessions-list.title: Active sessions
sessions-list.layout: Device rows + 'You' chip + per-row revoke + 'sign out everywhere' CTA
sessions-list.a11y: Each device announces label + location + last-seen
sessions-list.rtl: Rows mirror; revoke trailing in RTL

account-language.title: Language
account-language.layout: List of 4 first-class locales + numeral preview banner
account-language.a11y: Selection triggers live preview; restart prompt for full update
account-language.rtl: Arabic options show in Arabic font

not-found.title: NotFound 404
rules: Back-home preserves any in-progress flow if possible
Log to Sentry with allowlist scrub
